svg.title: GBufferA: world normal (native 10/10/10/2 packed)
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. GBufferA: world normal (native 10/10/10/2 packed) graph 0001 | BasePassParallel pass | RGB = WorldNormal*0.5+0.5 | view rect 0,0,1280,720 world normal N*0.5+0.5 no geometry (all 32 bits zero) Source: EncodeGBuffer -> OutGBufferA.rgb = EncodeNormal(WorldNormal) = N*0.5+0.5 (DeferredShadingCommon.ush:1003, EncodeNormal at :137). A is the 2-bit PerObjectGBufferData field; it is shown separately. Native format PF_A2B10G10R10, read from the stored file without expansion. World-space normal validity: non-background decoded N lengths are measured and reported in the manifest; A=0 is not treated as a normal.
